headline: Chromosome-level assemblies resolve sex chromosome and neo-Y evolution in beetles
label: Chromosome Scale Genome Assemblies
summary: Multiple new chromosome-level and sex-specific assemblies of beetles and a degu enable comparative analysis of young sex chromosomes.
synthesis: The dominant thread is chromosome-level genome assembly, here applied to sex chromosome biology in beetles alongside one mammalian reference. The degu preprint reports a chromosome-level HiFi and Hi-C assembly with improved contiguity, centromere and segmental duplication characterization, and annotation. The mountain pine beetle study presents six new de novo assemblies and describes stepwise neo-Y formation and rapid, population-specific neo-Y degeneration. The published Onthophagus binodis work provides sex-specific chromosome-level assemblies, a hybrid reference, repeat expansion analysis, and a putative Y. What is new is the pairing of multiple or sex-specific assemblies with explicit analysis of young, polymorphic sex chromosomes, allowing sex-linked sequence to be compared across assemblies.
